# SA Algal Bloom Monitor — Technical Inventory

**Document version:** 1.0
**Date produced:** 2026-05-27
**Author:** Generated by Claude Code from full project scan
**Status:** DRAFT — for manager review before approval

## Section 1 — Tech Stack Overview

| Layer | Technology | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Backend language | Python 3.11+ (AI_RULES target); Python 3.14 on AWS EB runtime | FastAPI application |
| Backend framework | FastAPI | REST API with automatic OpenAPI docs |
| ASGI server | Uvicorn (with `[standard]` extras) | Launched via Procfile |
| Frontend framework | React 19.x (Create React App) | Single-page application |
| Map rendering | Leaflet 1.9.x + react-leaflet 5.x | Interactive coastal bloom map |
| Primary database | Supabase PostgreSQL | Cloud-hosted, project ID: grhmoljiswegemumihlb |
| Local dev database | Microsoft SQL Server (SQL Express, Windows auth) | Dev only, not used in production |
| DB abstraction | Custom `db_config.py` | Switches between Postgres and SQL Server via `DATABASE_URL` env var |
| Machine learning | scikit-learn (RandomForest), LightGBM, joblib | Bloom severity classifier |
| RAG / vector store | ChromaDB | In-memory or persistent; used by Algal Assistant |
| LLM | OpenAI GPT-4o | Algal Assistant question answering |
| Satellite imagery | Google Earth Engine + Sentinel-2 COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED | SFABI bloom index calculation |
| Frontend hosting | Vercel (sa-bloom-dashboard.vercel.app) | Auto-deploy from main branch |
| Backend hosting | AWS Elastic Beanstalk, region ap-southeast-2 (Sydney) | Environment: sa-algal-bloom-api-env |
| Database hosting | Supabase (managed PostgreSQL) | |
| CI/CD automation | GitHub Actions | Daily 2am UTC cron; manual workflow_dispatch |
| Monitoring | UptimeRobot | Health ping every 5 minutes to /api/health |

## Section 2 — Backend Libraries

Source file: `requirements.txt`

| Package | Version constraint | What it does in this project | Files that use it |
|---|---|---|---|
| `requests` | unpinned | Makes HTTP GET calls to Open-Meteo weather API and SA Government ArcGIS feed | `data_ingestion/fetch_weather.py`, `data_ingestion/fetch_cell_counts.py`, `ml_engine/beach_safety_score.py` |
| `openai` | `>=1.0.0` | Calls OpenAI API for GPT-4o (Algal Assistant answers) and `text-embedding-3-small` (RAG vector queries) | `algal_assistant/rag_engine.py`, `api/main.py` |
| `chromadb` | `>=0.4.0` | Vector database that stores and queries knowledge-base text chunks for the Algal Assistant RAG pipeline | `algal_assistant/rag_engine.py`, `algal_assistant/build_knowledge_base.py` |
| `psycopg2` | unpinned | PostgreSQL adapter; connects to Supabase in all production data scripts | `db_config.py` (imported conditionally when `DATABASE_URL` is set) |
| `fastapi` | unpinned | Web framework that defines all REST API endpoints (`/api/health`, `/api/bloom-heatmap`, `/api/cell-counts`, `/api/weather`, `/api/forecast/72hr`, `/api/alerts`, `/api/beach-safety`, `/api/predict`, `/api/refresh`, `/api/algal-assistant`, `/api/refresh-status`) | `api/main.py` |
| `uvicorn[standard]` | unpinned | ASGI server that runs the FastAPI app; launched via `Procfile` (`web: uvicorn api.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000`) | `Procfile` |
| `pandas` | unpinned | Tabular data processing for CSV ingestion and data manipulation | `data_ingestion/load_ground_truth.py` and related ingestion scripts |
| `numpy` | unpinned | Numerical array operations for particle simulation, RBF interpolation, and ML training | `ml_engine/particle_tracker.py`, `ml_engine/train_classifier.py`, `data_ingestion/coastal_bloom_map.py` |
| `python-dotenv` | unpinned | Loads environment variables from `.env` file so scripts work locally without manual `export` | `db_config.py`, `api/main.py`, `algal_assistant/build_knowledge_base.py` |
| `scikit-learn` | unpinned | RandomForestClassifier for bloom severity prediction; LabelEncoder for class encoding; train/test split and classification reporting | `ml_engine/train_classifier.py`; model loaded at API startup in `api/main.py` |
| `lightgbm` | unpinned | Gradient-boosted tree library listed as an ML dependency; available for future model iterations or as an alternative classifier | `ml_engine/train_classifier.py` (available) |
| `joblib` | unpinned | Serialises and loads trained ML model files (`bloom_model.pkl`, `label_encoder.pkl`) | `ml_engine/train_classifier.py`, `api/main.py` |
| `scipy` | unpinned | Provides `RBFInterpolator` (Radial Basis Function) to interpolate Karenia cell counts from beach sample points onto 52 coastal grid points for the bloom heatmap | `data_ingestion/coastal_bloom_map.py` |
| `pydantic` | unpinned | Request/response schema validation in FastAPI; defines `AssistantRequest` model for the Algal Assistant endpoint | `api/main.py` |
| `httpx` | unpinned | Async-capable HTTP client; used internally by FastAPI's `[standard]` extras and available for async API calls | `api/main.py` (via FastAPI internals) |

**Note:** `earthengine-api` (the `ee` Python package) is imported in `data_ingestion/fetch_satellite.py` but is **not listed in requirements.txt**. It must be installed separately on any environment that runs the satellite fetch script.

**Note:** `pyodbc` is imported conditionally in `db_config.py` for local SQL Server connections but is **not in requirements.txt** (it is not needed on the production server where `DATABASE_URL` is set).

## Section 4 — Project File Structure

### Root directory

| File | Description |
|---|---|
| `AI_RULES.md` | Authoritative project coding rules, architecture decisions, and module boundaries — must be read by any AI or developer before modifying code |
| `db_config.py` | Database connection switcher: reads `DATABASE_URL` env var; connects to Supabase via psycopg2 (production) or SQL Server via pyodbc (local dev); provides `get_connection()`, `adapt_sql()`, `ph()` helpers used by all scripts |
| `refresh_data.py` | Orchestrator: the only entry point that calls all 7 data pipeline scripts in sequence; triggered by `POST /api/refresh` |
| `cron_trigger.py` | Called by GitHub Actions; pings the API health endpoint to wake the service before triggering the refresh |
| `requirements.txt` | Python package dependencies for the production environment |
| `Procfile` | Launch command for hosting platforms: `web: uvicorn api.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000` |
| `make_zip.py` | Utility script to create a deployment ZIP archive for AWS Elastic Beanstalk |

### `api/`

| File | Description |
|---|---|
| `api/main.py` | FastAPI application: defines all REST API endpoints; loads ML model at startup; handles CORS, refresh key auth, and JSON file serving |
| `api/__init__.py` | Package marker |

### `data_ingestion/`

| File | Description |
|---|---|
| `data_ingestion/fetch_weather.py` | Calls Open-Meteo API for 5 SA coastal locations; inserts hourly wind, SST, solar radiation, and wave height into `WeatherReadings` table |
| `data_ingestion/fetch_satellite.py` | Authenticates with Google Earth Engine via service account; fetches Sentinel-2 imagery over SA gulfs; calculates SFABI bloom index; writes `data/indices/bloom_heatmap_latest.geojson` |
| `data_ingestion/fetch_cell_counts.py` | Tries to fetch real Karenia cell count data from SA Government ArcGIS REST API; falls back to seeding realistic synthetic data if the API is unreachable; inserts into `KareniaReadings` |
| `data_ingestion/load_ground_truth.py` | Loads SA Gov Karenia readings from `sa_bloom_data.csv` and `old_sa_bloom_data.csv`; filters to Karenia species from September 2025 onwards; inserts latest reading per site into `KareniaReadings` |
| `data_ingestion/coastal_bloom_map.py` | Queries `KareniaReadings` DB; performs RBF (Radial Basis Function) spatial interpolation onto 52 coastal grid points; writes `data/indices/bloom_heatmap_latest.geojson` |
| `data_ingestion/fetch_ocean_currents.py` | Generates synthetic SA gulf ocean current data (Spencer Gulf + St Vincent Gulf tidal patterns); writes `data/ocean/currents.json` for the particle tracker |
| `data_ingestion/compute_indices.py` | Computes satellite spectral indices from raw data |
| `data_ingestion/fetch_real_bloom_data.py` | Fetches real bloom monitoring data |
| `data_ingestion/load_real_data.py` | Loads real-world data into the database |
| `data_ingestion/sa_bloom_data.csv` | SA Government Karenia site registry: site names, GPS coordinates; manually updated monthly |

### `ml_engine/`

| File | Description |
|---|---|
| `ml_engine/beach_safety_score.py` | Calculates 0–100 beach safety scores using SA Health cell count thresholds + Open-Meteo wind data + Sentinel-2 SFABI; writes `data/beach_safety_scores.json` |
| `ml_engine/particle_tracker.py` | Lagrangian particle simulation: seeds 800 bloom particles near Adelaide coast; runs 72-hour forward simulation using ocean currents + wind drift + tidal patterns; writes `data/forecasts/forecast_latest.json` |
| `ml_engine/train_classifier.py` | Trains a RandomForest classifier on weather + Karenia + SFABI data to predict bloom severity (Low/Medium/High/Critical); saves `bloom_model.pkl` and `label_encoder.pkl` |
| `ml_engine/live_gov_sync.py` | Syncs live SA Government monitoring data |
| `ml_engine/bloom_model.pkl` | Trained RandomForest classifier — committed to repository, loaded at API startup |
| `ml_engine/label_encoder.pkl` | LabelEncoder mapping severity strings to integer class indices — committed to repository |
| `ml_engine/__init__.py` | Package marker |

### `algal_assistant/`

| File | Description |
|---|---|
| `algal_assistant/rag_engine.py` | RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) engine: loads knowledge base `.txt` files; builds ChromaDB vector store; retrieves relevant chunks for a query; constructs GPT-4o prompt with live data + knowledge context |
| `algal_assistant/live_context.py` | Fetches live platform data directly from Supabase (KareniaReadings + WeatherReadings); avoids HTTP self-calls to prevent single-worker deadlock on Render |
| `algal_assistant/build_knowledge_base.py` | Standalone script: builds and tests the ChromaDB collection from `knowledge_base/*.txt` files; requires `OPENAI_API_KEY` |
| `algal_assistant/README.md` | Documentation for the Algal Assistant module |
| `algal_assistant/__init__.py` | Package marker |

### `frontend/sa-bloom-dashboard/src/`

| File | Description |
|---|---|
| `src/App.js` | Main React component: all state variables, API calls via axios, map rendering (Leaflet), tab navigation for all dashboard views |
| `src/App.css` | All styles including responsive media query breakpoints at 768px |
| `src/index.js` | React DOM entry point |
| `src/index.css` | Global base styles |
| `src/App.test.js` | Component tests |
| `src/setupTests.js` | Jest/testing-library configuration |
| `src/reportWebVitals.js` | Core Web Vitals performance reporting |

### `.github/workflows/`

| File | Description |
|---|---|
| `.github/workflows/daily_refresh.yml` | GitHub Actions workflow: runs at 2:00 AM UTC daily; wakes the API service (5 retries with 30s sleep); sends authenticated `POST /api/refresh` with `X-Refresh-Key` header; validates JSON response |

### `.ebextensions/`

| File | Description |
|---|---|
| `.ebextensions/01_packages.config` | AWS Elastic Beanstalk pre-install hook: runs `dnf install -y libpq-devel gcc python3-devel` so that `psycopg2` can compile its C extension against the PostgreSQL client library |

## Section 5 — External Services and APIs

| Service | Endpoint URL | Data provided | Script(s) that connect | Authentication |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Open-Meteo** | `https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast` | Hourly wind speed, wind direction, sea surface temperature, solar radiation, wave height for SA coastal locations | `data_ingestion/fetch_weather.py`, `ml_engine/beach_safety_score.py` | None — free public API, no key required |
| **SA Government Karenia ArcGIS** | `https://services.arcgis.com/R1y6RbNVeAYKQFOF/arcgis/rest/services/Algal_Bloom_Water_Testing/FeatureServer/0/query` | Real Karenia brevis cell counts (cells/litre) per beach site from SA Government field water sampling | `data_ingestion/fetch_cell_counts.py` | None — public ArcGIS REST service |
| **Google Earth Engine (Sentinel-2)** | `https://earthengine.googleapis.com` (via `earthengine-api` Python SDK) | Sentinel-2 multispectral imagery (bands B2, B3, B6, B7, B8, B12); used to compute SFABI (Spectral Feature for Algal Bloom Identification) and NDWI water mask over SA gulfs | `data_ingestion/fetch_satellite.py` | GEE service account: JSON credentials stored in `GEE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON` environment variable; GCP project: `smart-464108` |
| **OpenAI API** | `https://api.openai.com` | GPT-4o: natural language answers for the Algal Assistant; `text-embedding-3-small`: vector embeddings for RAG knowledge-base queries | `algal_assistant/rag_engine.py`, `api/main.py` | API key via `OPENAI_API_KEY` environment variable |
| **Supabase PostgreSQL** | `db.grhmoljiswegemumihlb.supabase.co` (via psycopg2 connection string) | Persistent storage for all platform data: KareniaReadings, WeatherReadings, and all other tables | `db_config.py` (imported by all data scripts and `api/main.py`) | Connection string via `DATABASE_URL` environment variable (Postgres URL format) |
| **Marine Safety SA cameras** | Live camera feeds from SA coastal locations | Real-time visual feed of coastal conditions for the Live Cameras dashboard tab | `frontend/sa-bloom-dashboard/src/App.js` | As configured per camera endpoint |
| **UptimeRobot** | `https://uptimerobot.com` (external monitor) | Health monitoring — pings `GET /api/health` every 5 minutes; alerts on downtime | External service — no project code calls it | Configured via UptimeRobot dashboard (not in codebase) |

## Section 7 — How to Update This Document

This document must be updated whenever any of the following changes occur:

- **A new library is added to `requirements.txt` or `package.json`** — add a row to Section 2 or Section 3 with the package name, version, role in the project, and which files use it.
- **A new external API or data source is integrated** — add a row to Section 5 with the service name, endpoint URL, data provided, consuming script, and authentication method.
- **A new script or module is created** — add it to the relevant folder group in Section 4 with a one-line description of its purpose.
- **Infrastructure or hosting changes** — update Section 6 to reflect the new platform, region, URL, or deployment method.
- **The tech stack changes** (new language, framework, or database) — update Section 1.

The document owner is responsible for keeping this register accurate. Out-of-date inventory documents create onboarding risk and can cause deployment failures when dependencies or services are not accounted for.
